answer: The Computer Science minor gives students basic CS proficiency and market-demanded computing skills: analyzing problems and computing requirements, using current tools, and programming in modern languages.

source_quote: This minor is offered to all RHU students except those in CCE and Business IT
answer: The CS minor is open to all RHU students except those in Computer and Communications Engineering (CCE) and Business IT Management; students must declare their intent early in their major using the appropriate form.

answer: CS minor students need a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and at least 6 credit hours of the minor must not count toward their major or any other minor.

source_quote: Graduates of this minor can seek jobs in software engineering, web and mobile
answer: CS minor holders can pursue jobs in software engineering, web and mobile development, database/system administration, network engineering, and IT consultancy.

source_quote: The Computer Science minor consists of six courses (18 credits), of which two are
answer: The CS minor is six courses (18 credits): mandatory COSC 214 and COSC 215 (6 credits) plus four electives (12 credits) chosen with the minor advisor from COSC 231, 316, 333, 341, 351, 434, 435, 436, 438, 451, 480, 481, 482, or other approved CS electives.

source_quote: Graduates of this minor will be able to use their acquired skills across various industries
answer: The Data Analytics minor prepares students to collect and store data, apply analytics to decision-making, and design tools to interpret and visualize data, for sectors such as telecom, banking, energy, biomedical and government, and for graduate study.

source_quote: This minor is offered to all RHU students except CCE students.
answer: The Data Analytics minor is open to all RHU students except CCE students (aimed at BE/BS students in engineering, computer science and business), and may be offered to BS/BE holders from other universities case by case.

answer: To complete the DA minor a student must submit the Minor Declaration Form, get approval from their college dean and the CAS dean, keep a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and complete 18 credits, with at least 6 credits not counted toward their major or another minor.

source_quote: Moreover, minor holders may assume specialized roles such as data scientists, data
answer: Data Analytics minor holders can work in telecom, banking, finance, environment, energy, biomedical, police, biology and physics, in roles such as data scientist, data analyst and data engineer.

source_quote: The three mandatory courses (9 credits) are:
answer: DA minor mandatory courses (9 credits): BADM 250 Business Statistics or MATH 351 Probability and Statistics; COSC 480 Machine Learning and Data Mining; and CCEE 567 Optimization or BADM 420 Quantitative Methods for Business.

source_quote: Students may choose three elective courses (9 credits) from the following list or any
answer: DA minor electives (choose three, 9 credits): COSC 316, COSC 481, COSC 482, CCEE 516, CCEE 568, CCEE 561, CCEE 566, CCEE 612, BITM 320, BITM 415, BMKA 420, or other approved courses. CBA students (except BITM) may also choose COSC 214, COSC 231 or COSC 333.

source_quote: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of applied multivariate statistics.
answer: In the Data Analytics minor description, BADM 250 Business Statistics, 3(3,0), covers applied multivariate statistics: factor analysis, multiple regression, discriminant analysis, ANOVA and hypothesis testing.
review_note: This description (p.154) differs from the gen-ed description of BADM 250 on p.105 (random variables, sampling, probability, simple regression).

source_quote: This course introduces students to statistical techniques for analyzing large datasets.
answer: BITM 350 Fundamentals of Data Analytics, 3(3,0): parametric and nonparametric techniques for large datasets, univariate/bivariate visualization, factor and cluster analysis, and linear, logistic and time-series predictive models.

source_quote: logistic, and time-series models. Prerequisite: BADM 250 or MATH 351.
answer: The prerequisite for BITM 350 Fundamentals of Data Analytics is BADM 250 or MATH 351.

source_quote: This course introduces business intelligence as computerized support for managerial
answer: BITM 415 Business Intelligence, 3(3,0): BI as computerized decision support, BI tools and techniques, reporting and visual analytics, with hands-on dashboards and visualizations.

source_quote: dashboards. Prerequisite: Senior Standing & BADM 350
answer: The prerequisites for BITM 415 Business Intelligence are Senior Standing and the course printed as BADM 350.

answer: BMKA 420 Digital and Social Media Marketing, 3(3,0): social media, email and mobile marketing, SEO, paid search, content marketing, and measuring digital campaigns. Prerequisite: Senior Standing.

source_quote: This course will introduce students to database management, querying, and data
answer: CCEE 516 Advanced Programming and Database Management Systems: database management, querying, data warehousing and big data tools (Bigtable, NoSQL, R, Python, Scala, MapReduce, Elasticsearch). Prerequisite: CCEE 315 or equivalent.
review_note: Credit notation 3(3,0) in description (p.155) vs 3(2,2) in DA elective list (p.154).

answer: CCEE 561 Computer Vision, 3(3,0): image structure, projection, stereo vision, visual motion and industrial/robotic applications such as autonomous navigation and hand-eye coordination.

source_quote: novel man-machine interfaces. Prerequisite: CCEE 214 or COSC 214.
answer: The prerequisite for CCEE 561 Computer Vision is CCEE 214 or COSC 214.

answer: CCEE 566 Natural Language Processing, 3(3,0): tokenization, text classification, sentiment analysis, spelling correction, information extraction, parsing, question answering, n-gram models, naive Bayes and maxent classifiers, HMMs and vector-space models.

answer: CCEE 567 Optimization, 3(3,0): optimization theory and algorithms - linear programming, network optimization, integer programming and decision trees - with a team project. Prerequisite: MATH 215 or equivalent.

source_quote: Equivalent to BADM 420 and
answer: CCEE 567 Optimization is equivalent to BADM 420 and MECH 571.

source_quote: This course enables students to understand why the Big Data Era has emerged.
answer: CCEE 568 Big Data and Analytics/Big Data System, 3(3,0): big data concepts, applications and systems, and the Hadoop framework. Prerequisite: CCEE 564 or equivalent.

source_quote: In this course, advanced data mining topics will be covered, namely, classification
answer: CCEE 612 Advanced Data Mining, 3(3,0): LDA/QDA and neural network classification, ensemble learning (bagging, boosting, stacking), dimensionality reduction, deep learning, anomaly detection and reinforcement learning. Prerequisite: CCEE 564 or equivalent.
